{"reason":"Add the high-confidence gate before returning true. Six of the eight displayed false-arbitration rows have confidence below 0.7, so the edit removes those costly positives while leaving magnitude, exposure, and frozen tests intact for high-confidence events, protecting recall >=0.8. V1's FAR is 0.714 (20/28).","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure)
  (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15)
       (> inventory-exposure 500000)
       (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change))
       (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
